_comment: day-rhythm-business-and-combat ticket 14: bounded solo combat prototype (rules per ticket 13a) -- prototype-only, NOT production balance, not cross-referenced by REFERENCE.md. encounterOrder is the fixed teaching sequence (brawler -> knifeFighter -> enforcer per the ticket). Each encounter's `script` is the enemy's deterministic committed-action cycle, always aimed at the player, so the fight reliably surfaces the specific matchup(s) it's named to teach rather than leaving it to chance -- CombatPrototype only advances an enemy's script index on a round it actually commits (an exhausted skip round doesn't consume a step). PROSE-REVIEW: every `name`/`intro` string here is new copy, drafted against CONTENT-GUIDE.md's tone bible.

brawler.name: The Brawler
brawler.intro: He squares up, all shoulders. Nothing subtle about what's coming.

knifeFighter.name: The Knife Fighter
knifeFighter.intro: Quick on her feet, blade held low. She won't telegraph much.

enforcer.name: The Enforcer
enforcer.intro: He's done this before -- watching for an opening, not just swinging.
